recordingControl.description: Optional. Whether the conversation may be recorded and logged from here on. Use this when the app, rather than the agent, decides what may be kept: for example when the end user has to consent to being recorded before anything about the call can be stored. The value stays in effect until the client sends a different one, so it only needs to be sent when the answer changes. Whatever is in effect when a turn completes decides that turn, both whether its audio reaches the recording bucket and whether its transcript reaches conversation history, BigQuery and Cloud Logging. It covers the agent's side of the turn as well as the end user's. Turns that complete before the client first sends this are recorded according to the app's logging settings, as though the field did not exist. If more than one input in the same request sets it, the last one wins.

Providing a display name during reimport will result in an INVALID_ARGUMENT error.

ignoreAppLock.description: Optional. Flag for overriding the app lock during import. If set to true, the import process will ignore the app lock.

appId.description: Optional. The ID to use for the imported app. * If not specified, a unique ID will be automatically assigned for the app. * Otherwise, the imported app will use this ID as the final component of its resource name. If an app with the same ID already exists at the specified location in the project, the content of the existing app will be replaced.

importOptions.description: Optional. Options governing the import process for the app.

appContent.description: Raw bytes representing the compressed zip file with the app folder structure.

jsonPatchGcsUri.description: Optional. A Cloud Storage URI pointing to a JSON file containing the patches.

acceptedOutputModes.description: A list of media types the client is prepared to accept for response parts. Agents SHOULD use this to tailor their output.

returnImmediately.description: If `true`, the operation returns immediately after creating the task, even if processing is still in progress. recaptchaToken.description: Optional. The reCAPTCHA token generated by the client-side chat widget.

Tool.description: A tool represents an action that the CES agent can take to achieve certain goals.

createTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the tool was created.

executionType.description: Optional. The execution type of the tool.

generatedSummary.description: Output only. If the tool is generated by the LLM assistant, this field contains a descriptive summary of the generation.

displayName.description: Output only. The display name of the tool, derived based on the tool's type. For example, display name of a ClientFunction is derived from its `name` property.

mcpTool.description: Optional. The MCP tool. An MCP tool cannot be created or updated directly and is managed by the MCP toolset.

timeout.description: Optional. The timeout for the tool execution. If not set, the default timeout is 30 seconds for `SYNCHRONOUS` tools and 60 seconds for `ASYNCHRONOUS` tools.

toolFakeConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for tool behavior in fake mode.

readOnly.description: Output only. Indicates whether the tool is read-only. If true, the tool cannot be modified by the user.

AssistantConfirmationResponse.description: The user's answer to an AssistantConfirmationRequest, sent on the next SessionService.StreamChatAiAssistant call to resume the paused agent.

confirmed.description: Binary answer: true approves the paused action, false declines it.

answerText.description: The chosen option's submit_text, or free-form user text. The paused action is cancelled and the text is handed to the agent to act on.

enableRedaction.description: Optional. If `true`, redaction will be applied in various logging scenarios, including conversation history, Cloud Logging and audio recording.

deidentifyTemplate.description: Optional. [DLP](https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs) deidentify template name to instruct on how to de-identify content. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/deidentifyTemplates/{deidentify_template}`

tool.description: Required. The original name of the tool as it is emitted by the MCP server.

snapshot.description: Output only. If present, this tool is "Pinned" and uses the snapshot values as fallbacks if the server becomes temporarily unavailable or if no Override is present.

tlsConfig.description: Optional. The TLS configuration. Includes the custom server certificates

condition.description: Required. An expression which specifies a boost condition. The syntax is the same as filter expression syntax. Currently, the only supported condition is a list of BCP-47 lang codes. Example: To boost suggestions in languages en or fr: (lang_code: ANY("en", "fr"))

boost.description: Optional. Strength of the boost, which should be in [-1, 1]. Negative boost means demotion. Default is 0.0. Setting to 1.0 gives the suggestions a big promotion. However, it does not necessarily mean that the top result will be a boosted suggestion. Setting to -1.0 gives the suggestions a big demotion. However, other suggestions that are relevant might still be shown. Setting to 0.0 means no boost applied. The boosting condition is ignored.

boostControlSpec.description: Optional. Complex specification for custom ranking based on customer defined attribute value.

supportedLanguageCodes.description: Optional. List of languages codes supported by the app, in addition to the `default_language_code`.

fallbackAction.description: Optional. Deprecated: This feature is no longer supported. Use `enable_multilingual_support` instead to improve handling of multilingual input. The action to perform when an agent receives input in an unsupported language. This can be a predefined action or a custom tool call. Valid values are: - A tool's full resource name, which triggers a specific tool execution. - A predefined system action, such as "escalate" or "exit", which triggers an EndSession signal with corresponding metadata to terminate the conversation.

enableMultilingualSupport.description: Optional. Enables multilingual support. If `true`, agents in the app will use pre-built instructions to improve handling of multilingual input.

defaultLanguageCode.description: Optional. The default language code of the app.

resumeFromSequenceNumber.description: Optional. Optional cursor to resume and replay events from an in-flight or completed turn.

confirmationResponse.description: Optional. The user's answer to a pending AssistantConfirmationRequest. When set, the server resumes the paused agent with this answer instead of (or in addition to) starting a new prompt turn.

attachOnly.description: Optional. Optional flag to attach to an existing in-flight turn without submitting a new message.

operationCompletedEvent.description: Optional. Resumes an assistant session paused waiting for a client-managed long-running operation to complete.

clientCapabilities.description: Optional. Response features this client can render. The server only emits events that need a capability (e.g. `confirmation_request`) when the capability is declared, so older clients never receive events they would silently drop.

enumDescriptions: Unspecified capability; ignored.
The client renders AssistantConfirmationRequest cards and answers them via `confirmation_response`.

The client manages long-running operations out-of-band by polling the operation and sending `operation_completed_event` to resume the turn. If not declared, the server manages LRO polling and completes the turn inline.
The client renders project-scope events: `typed_payload` cards, `target_app` on tool calls and responses, `targets` on confirmation requests and `touched_apps` on turn completion.

message.description: Optional. The message to send to the assistant agent. May be empty when `confirmation_response` is set (answering a pending confirmation without adding a new message); at least one of the two must be provided.
